subject: checks @f6f7fb1: tests/content/test_generate_cards.py::test_committed_files_are_fresh fails, 3 stale cards.generated.json (also fails CI's content-library step)
body:

- neuro-behavioral: 4f87e1e (s23e batch 2) -> seg23-e
- renal-endo-nutrition: 281db11 (s23c batch 2) -> seg23-c
